name: Randomized Littlestone Dimension of Warmuth's $C_5$ Class
proof: Enumerate the ten cyclic $1001$ concepts and apply the finite randomized-tree recurrence $R(V)=\max_x(1+R(V_{x=0})+R(V_{x=1}))/2$ to every version space V. The exact dynamic program gives $R(C_5)=13/8$; the repository's C5 verifier checks this with rational arithmetic.
